SELECT id FROM coupons WHERE discount_value = #{discount} ORDER BY RANDOM() LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO users_coupons (user_id, coupon_id) VALUES (#{userId}, #{couponId}) ON CONFLICT (user_id, coupon_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT c.code FROM users_coupons uc JOIN coupons c ON uc.coupon_id = c.id WHERE uc.user_id = #{userId} AND DATE(uc.acquired_at) = CURRENT_DATE ORDER BY uc.acquired_at DESC LIMIT 1
